study_identification_part.si4_title: Deviations From Normative Functioning Underlying Emotional Episodic Memory Revealed Cross-Scale Neurodiverse Alterations Linked to Affective Symptoms in Distinct Psychiatric Disorders

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states the aim to investigate cross-scale neural dysfunctions in psychiatric disorders using normative modeling. It describes the purpose of normative modeling (disentangling heterogeneity) and provides a specific hypothesis about convergence/divergence of deviations.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In the current study, we aimed to investigate cross-scale neural dysfunctions related to affective symptoms in patients with MDD, BD, and SZ... By utilizing 2 task-fMRI datasets and a normative modeling framework... The normative modeling approach enables the disentangling of the cross-scale heterogeneous patterns of neural dysfunctions underlying affective symptoms... we hypothesized that individualized deviations would converge in limited regions but diverge significantly across large-scale networks between diagnoses.
